audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven chart entries disagreed with its own why: level 1 was 'Skill' while whys[0] says you out-range him, level 3 was yours while whys[2] hands it to Counter Strike, and both item stages were yours while whys[5] and whys[6] say he stat-checks you.
audit.why: Counter Strike at level 3, Grandmaster-at-Arms at 6 and a Trinity/Botrk spike are all his; your clean stages are level 1 and the pre-item 4-5 window.
audit.corrected: Jayce, Skill, Jax, Jayce, Jax, Jax, Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why said 'Jax's ultimate changes the math too' as boilerplate.
audit.why: Grandmaster-at-Arms is 110s at rank 1 and gives bonus Armor and MR plus his third-hit magic damage — a real spike against a Jayce who builds no defensive stats and gets nothing new at 6.
audit.corrected: Level 6 named as his, with the resist swing spelled out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four places say Counter Strike dodges your gate-Q ('a lazy gate-Q thrown inside his auto range lets him dodge it').
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges incoming basic ATTACKS, not abilities. Shock Blast is a spell and lands through it; what Counter Strike actually blanks is your Hyper Charge auto-attack burst. The real danger is standing inside the stun radius when it expires, not throwing the orb.
audit.corrected: Keep firing the orb through Counter Strike; hold Hyper Charge until it ends and stay out of the stun radius.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Counter Strike' with no number anywhere.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s and Leap Strike 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s — the gap between them is why a spent E is a real walk-up window early and almost none by rank 5.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and the do.

audit.whatIsWrong: Empower is never identified as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Empower (7/6/5/4/3s) resets his attack, so the burst opens on the swing animation rather than on a cast — the wind-up is the cue to swap and knock him back, not the ability itself.
audit.corrected: Named in the Key Ability Interactions block.

edits.before: Jax's biggest early threat: Counter Strike is up, so a lazy gate-Q thrown inside his auto range lets him dodge it, recast E to stun, then Leap Strike + Empower on top for the all-in.
edits.after: Jax's biggest early threat: Counter Strike is up. It cannot dodge Shock Blast, only your autos, but step inside its radius and he recasts E to stun, then Leap Strike + Empower on top for the all-in.

edits.before: Bait or eat your gate-Q on Counter Strike, recast E to stun, then Leap Strike + Empower for the all-in
edits.after: Pull you inside Counter Strike's radius, recast E to stun, then Leap Strike + Empower for the all-in

edits.before: Jax's Counter Strike comes online: one mistimed gate-Q in auto range lets him dodge it, recast E to stun, and Leap Strike + Empower for the all-in.
edits.after: Jax's Counter Strike comes online: it blanks your Hyper Charge autos, and standing inside its radius gets you stunned into Leap Strike + Empower.

edits.before: Cannon-form Q is your whole opening -- take Shock Blast at level 1 and gate-Q his step-ups before Jax has Counter Strike to answer you. The moment you hit 2-3, the accelerated orb through Acceleration Gate plus the cannon-swap first-hit Armor/MR shred chunks anyone who walked up to last-hit, so make him choose between farm and face. The one trap: at level 3 his Counter Strike is up, so never throw a lazy gate-Q from inside his auto range -- if he dodges it and recasts E to stun, his Leap Strike + Empower is on you instantly. Poke from max range, swap to Hammer only to Thundering-Blow a committed leap out of range, then swap back to re-poke.
edits.after: Cannon-form Q is your whole opening -- take Shock Blast at level 1 and gate-Q his step-ups before Jax has Counter Strike to answer you. The moment you hit 2-3, the accelerated orb through Acceleration Gate plus the cannon-swap first-hit Armor/MR shred chunks anyone who walked up to last-hit, so make him choose between farm and face. The one trap: at level 3 Counter Strike is up, and while it cannot dodge Shock Blast it does blank your Hyper Charge autos -- stand inside its radius and the recast stun feeds you Leap Strike + Empower. Poke from max range, swap to Hammer only to Thundering-Blow a committed leap out of range, then swap back to re-poke.

edits.before: Form-swapping IS the ult — six abilities against his four. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Jax's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grandmaster-at-Arms is 110s of bonus resists and third-hit magic damage; your R is only the stance-swap, so this level is his.

edits.before: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Counter Strike (E): 17s at rank 1 but only 9s by rank 5 — it dodges autos, not your orb. - Leap Strike: 8s at rank 1. - Empower: 7s, and it resets his attack. - Grandmaster-at-Arms: 110s.

edits.before: Track Jax's Counter Strike: Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. When it is down — Cannon-Q + hammer him.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges attacks, not spells — your orb lands through it; hold Hyper Charge until it ends.

edits.before: Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His dodge-and-stun, 17s at rank 1. It blanks autos, never your orb.
